usedFor: Browse AI extracts web data, and each “Table Export” can open work in Asana.

bestTemplate.name: “Table Export” in Browse AI, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A finished table export becomes an Asana task, so someone reviews the scraped data.

watchOut: “New Tasks” in Browse AI fires when a task finishes successfully, not when one is created.
